status: locally frozen synthetic task protocol, not external preregistration
public_information: Identical source, canonical producer/consumer signatures, allowed edits, and candidate order for every arm. No strategy receives world IDs, private registries, other arms' answers, or validation answers.
private_information: Internal display labels only; semantic types and acceptance are invariant across the 16 worlds.
candidate_order: SHA-256 of public task ID and producer choices, independent of world and arm; exclude the already-rejected initial candidate.
repair_goal: Type-check while preserving the template byte-for-byte except producer selection holes. No claim of runtime functional correctness.
privacy_endpoint: Additional world-pair distinctions in complete JSON responses, exhaustively over every allowed candidate, conditional on the same public task and verdict. Each input has 120 eligible world pairs.
utility_endpoint: Success by budget 2 and mean frontend query count, paired by public task; private worlds are nested repetitions, not independent tasks.
superiority_rule: Both projected_local and redacted_public must have zero extra distinctions on the full finite edit domain. Projected_local must improve layout-check task success by budget 2 by at least 0.10 over redacted_public and have no negative success difference in any layout-check family. A gain over redacted_local alone does not satisfy the rule.
infrastructure_errors: Abort; never convert crashes, timeouts, stderr, malformed responses, or missing diagnostics into successful evidence or silently exclude them.
boundaries: No population inference or novelty claim
Layout checks are not a blinded independent holdout
Cached query views count as queries; runtime is not an endpoint
